scores.Biological Plausibility_reason: Kir2.1 can plausibly increase resting potassium conductance and thereby lower input resistance. However, the asserted high-Kcnj2 Pvalb and low-Kcnj2 Vip/Sst pattern, and its status as a primary established driver, are not firmly supported by the cited broad Patch-seq studies.

Those cell identities are primarily presumed expression strata rather than mechanistically explained determinants, and morphology is treated only as an excluded alternative. No formal ceiling was applied; the score reflects a clear central mechanism with limited contextual integration and mechanistic depth.
